subject: Draft: Squad consolidation & leadership responsibility updates
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Squad consolidation & leadership responsibility updates

Team —

Attached is a first-pass comms draft proposing the consolidation of three product squads into two lanes (Search & Relevance, and Cost/Platform). The goal: eliminate duplication across ranking work, simplify escalation paths, and make leadership spans more consistent ahead of the QBR.

High-level ask: please review the attached doc (squad_consolidation_draft_v1.docx) and the org_impact_matrix.xlsx by EOD Tuesday (Nov 17). I want a clean comms memo we can share with the broader org during the QBR week if we have approvals.

Key areas I tried to anticipate:
- How this affects current OKRs / countersigning for cross-squad goals
- Geos & customers with active escalations (we'll need tailored routing)
- Career path clarity for ICs whose squad lead will shift

Proposed cadence: announce high-level changes in the QBR presentation (Nov 23), follow up with team-specific AMA sessions the week after. If we need to adjust timing for region-specific reasons, flag that now.

Resources attached: same tracker with headcount impact and proposed owner for each open role. I purposely left the tone conservative — factual, prioritizing career continuity. Happy to harden language.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: squad_consolidation_draft_v1.docx (draft comms), org_impact_matrix.xlsx (role mapping & headcount delta)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: Squad consolidation & leadership responsibility updates

Hannah — thanks for pulling this together, good clarity. Quick read-through notes:

- Front-load the memo with why (customer latency/cost complexity + duplicated PM/Eng work) — executives want the business case up front.
- Add a short Q/A section for managers to cut/paste into team AMAs ("who to talk to about my role, how will comp be handled")
- Reframe one paragraph that currently reads as a cost-reduction first step; swap to "efficiency and clearer ownership" to reduce anxiety.

Small edits inline in the doc; high-level: I support consolidating the squads, but we should commit to specific growth paths for the impacted ICs (6-month checkpoints). Also recommend we give managers a recommended script for 1:1s.

If useful I can take a pass at the QBR slide wording and share a version for review.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Head of Engineering, Platform
Redwood Inference
